questions.question:
Arrange the following words in the order in which they appear in an English dictionary.

1. Heist 2. Height 3. Heart 4. Hackle 5. Higher
questions.solution:
Hackle comes first.

It is followed by Heart.

Heart is followed by Height.

Height is followed by Heist.

Heist is followed by Higher.

The correct dictionary order is,

Hackle (4) → Heart (3) → Height (2) → Heist (1) → Higher (5)

Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.
